info.name: Restaurant Owner Portal
info.description: End-to-end `ROLE_RESTAURANT_OWNER` API collection: multi-step restaurant onboarding, cuisine category proposals, storefront & schedule operations, menu & dish image management, kitchen order fulfillment & earnings analytics, notifications, and presigned S3 uploads. Pair with the `Restaurant Owner Portal - Local Dev` environment.

item.name: Auth & Session Management
User Registration
item.description: Public self-registration endpoint (`noauth`) that creates a `ROLE_RESTAURANT_OWNER` account with Argon2 password hashing (`201 Created`). Follow with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` to start a device session.

item.name: Login & Token Refresh
item.description: Argon2 credential login and silent refresh token rotation (`noauth`). Requires `X-Client-Type: web_browser | mobile_app` and automatically populates `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `challenge_token`, and `session_id` via Postman test scripts.

item.name: Device Session Management
item.description: Resolves `409 Conflict` concurrent session limit challenges using `Authorization: Bearer {{challenge_token}}` (`SCOPE_AUTH`): list active sessions (`GET /sessions`), revoke an old device (`DELETE /sessions/{sessionId}`), and claim the new session (`POST /claim-session`).

item.name: Logout
item.description: Single-device (`/logout`) and global all-device (`/logout-all`) session revocation in PostgreSQL and Redis (`SCOPE_API`), clearing the `refreshToken` cookie.

Authentication and session lifecycle: Argon2 self-registration, dual-audience RSA JWT issuance (`quickbite-api` 15m + `quickbite-auth` 5m), `X-Client-Type`-aware SHA-256 refresh token rotation (`HttpOnly` cookie for `web_browser`, JSON body for `mobile_app`), and Yauaa device session tracking.

item.description: Step-by-step merchant onboarding workflow (`DRAFT` → `SUBMITTED`, plus `reopen` when `REJECTED`): basic details, street address & PostGIS coordinates, weekly operating hours, gallery images, and `FSSAI_LICENSE` / `GST` / `PAN` / `BANK_PROOF` / `BUSINESS_LICENSE` verification documents.

item.name: Cuisine Proposals
item.description: Propose new cuisine categories (`PENDING`) for Admin moderation before attaching them to menu items.

item.name: Restaurant Operations & Schedule
item.description: Manage approved restaurants owned by the merchant: update restaurant profile, replace weekly operating hours, manage gallery images, and toggle temporary open/closed status.

item.name: Kitchen Order Fulfillment
Get Kitchen Order Delivery Agent Details

request.description: Fetches details and live coordinates of the delivery partner assigned for order pickup from the restaurant. (RestaurantOrderController#getAssignedDeliveryAgent | ROLE_RESTAURANT_OWNER)
Aggregates delivered order metrics, gross sales, platform commission deductions, food subtotal, and net payout for an owned restaurant. (RestaurantOrderController#getEarnings | ROLE_RESTAURANT_OWNER)

item.description: List and inspect restaurant orders (filterable by `OrderStatus`), accept or decline incoming `PLACED` orders within the 2-minute window, advance kitchen preparation (`ACCEPTED` → `PREPARING` → `READY_FOR_PICKUP`), view assigned courier details, and query delivered sales & earnings summaries (`/orders/earnings`).

item.name: In-App Notifications
item.description: Fetch, count unread, and mark polymorphic joined-inheritance in-app notifications as read (`OrderNotification`, `PaymentNotification`, `RestaurantApplicationNotification`, `DeliveryAgentApplicationNotification`, `VehicleApplicationNotification`, `CuisineNotification`).

item.name: Presigned S3 File Uploads
item.description: Generate short-lived presigned AWS S3 `PUT` URLs (`uploadUrl` + `fileUrl`) for direct client uploads (`RESTAURANT_IMAGE`, `RESTAURANT_DOCUMENT`).
